name: RetroAct Environment Annotations and Rollout Generator
summary: 覆盖 974 个游戏环境的标注与回放生成工具，用于动作条件世界模型；不把环境数量当作已下载轨迹数量。
summaryEn: Annotations and rollout-generation tools for 974 game environments used in action-conditioned world modeling; environment counts are not recorded-trajectory counts.
scale: 974 annotated retro game environments; datasets generated from hundreds of environments
scaleZh: 974 个标注复古游戏环境，可从数百环境生成轨迹数据
access: Official repository includes environment annotations, data-generation, training, and evaluation code
accessZh: 官方仓库提供环境标注、数据生成、训练和评测代码
verdict: 覆盖 974 个游戏环境的标注与回放生成工具，用于动作条件世界模型；不把环境数量当作已下载轨迹数量。
verdictEn: Annotations and rollout-generation tools for 974 game environments used in action-conditioned world modeling; environment counts are not recorded-trajectory counts.
wmNote: 控制标注与自动探索回放可直接产生动作到未来观测的训练样本。
wmNoteEn: Control metadata and exploration rollouts directly produce action-to-future-observation training samples.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - insait-institute/GenieRedux: A framework for training world models with virtual environments, complete with annotated environment dataset (RetroAct), exploration agent (AutoExplore Agent), and GenieRedux-G - an implementation of Genie with enhancements · GitHub
evidence.statement: RetroAct annotates 974 game environments and the repository gives executable action-aligned dataset-generation commands. Environment annotations are not 974 independent trajectory datasets.
